note: ISC (Indian School Certificate) is CISCE's senior-secondary curriculum, covering ONLY Class 11 and Class 12 — unlike the sibling icse.json, which covers Class 6-10 under the same council. Unit/chapter names and order are fetched from official cisce.org syllabus PDFs (downloaded 2026-07-06 with a browser user-agent, since CISCE blocks plain fetches) for Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Computer Science and Economics at both grades, and for Biology Class 12. The official cisce.org Class 11 Biology PDF returned 404 at the time of research, so Class 11 Biology unit names and weightage are taken from a byjus.com-hosted mirror of the same official CISCE document (fetched-secondary) and cross-checked against vedantu.com's unit breakdown, which matched exactly. Topic-level blurbs are a faithful plain-English decomposition of each unit's real sub-topics, written from the fetched syllabus text where available and from standard Class 11-12 science/commerce curriculum knowledge where the source only listed a unit title. ISC has no subject called 'Social Science' at this level — CISCE offers separate electives (History, Political Science, Economics, Geography, Commerce, etc.) instead of one combined subject. 'Economics' was chosen as the stand-in for the Social Science bucket because it is one of the most widely taken ISC electives; it is a real, distinct ISC subject, not an approximation of a subject called 'Social Science'.
